title: Champagne Tower
goal: Find how full a queried champagne glass is after overflow settles.
strategy: Each glass holds one unit. Any excess splits equally between the two glasses below; propagating row by row accumulates contributions from both parents before the next overflow calculation.

edgeCases: No poured champagne leaves every glass empty
Exactly one unit fills the top without overflow
A heavily supplied queried glass caps at one
